name: @portal/desktop-electron
description: Electron desktop shell for Sovereign Portal C-137 (NSIS installer + single-file portable executable)

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run build:ts && electron .
scripts.dist:nsis: npm run build:ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win portable
